welcome:
👋 Group mein swagat hai, {name}!

🌐 Neeche apni language chuniye.
help:
🆘 *Bot Help*

▶️ /start — Group mein bot setup karein
⚙️ /settings — Settings kholein (sirf admins)
🌐 /setlanguage <code> — Group ki default language set karein (sirf admins)
🗣️ /language — Apni personal language choose karein
🆘 /help — Ye message dikhayein

🛡️ Security: anti-spam, flood protection, bad-word filter, 18+ media protection
📢 Force Join: members ko required channel/group join karna hoga
⚠️ Warning system: baar-baar violation par mute/block
🌍 Multi-language support
setup_start: 🚀 Group ke liye bot setup ho raha hai...
setup_need_admin: 🔐 Pehle mujhe *admin* banayein, delete messages, ban aur restrict users ki permission ke saath.
setup_done:
✅ Setup complete! Main active hoon aur is group ko protect kar raha hoon.
👑 Owner: {owner}
already_setup: ⚡ Ye group pehle se setup ho chuka hai aur main active hoon.
not_owner_or_admin: 🚫 Ye sirf group owner ya authorized admin kar sakte hain.
settings_title:
⚙️ *Group Settings*
Feature on/off karne ke liye button dabayein.
force_join_prompt: 📢 Pehle hamara channel aur group join karein, phir Verify dabayein:
verify_success: ✅ Verify ho gaya! Ab aap chat kar sakte hain.
verify_fail: ❌ Aapne abhi dono join nahi kiye. Pehle join karein phir try karein.
warning_limit_reached: 🚫 {name} ki warning limit puri ho gayi, restrict kar diya gaya.
bad_word_deleted: 🗑️ Ek message gaali/bad word ki wajah se hata diya gaya.
spam_deleted: 🛡️ Ek message spam hone ki wajah se hata diya gaya.
flood_muted: 🌊 {name} ko flooding ki wajah se temporarily mute kar diya gaya.
media_deleted: 🔞 Unsafe media detect hui aur hata di gayi.
unauthorized_action: ⚠️ Unauthorized action ki koshish block kar di gayi.
unauthorized_command: ⚠️ Aapko ye command use karne ki permission nahi hai.
admin_removed: ➖ {name} ki admin permissions hata di gayi.
log_auto_request_approved: 🤖 {name} ki join request auto-approve ki gayi.
